lore: Nobody on DiskSaver Island carries the whole island in their pack. Pelicans fly each stretch of path in from the archive just before the traveller needs it. A pelican takes a few ticks to return, so the flock must leave ahead of the traveller's feet. Send too few ahead and the traveller waits at every step; send a whole flock and the next ferry to another island leaves them all circling over a path nobody will walk.

lines.start: Twelve hundred stretches of path and a flock that takes four ticks a flight. Send them ahead of your feet.
lines.flight: Off they go. They'll be back with the next stretch before you reach it, if you sent them early enough.
lines.ferry: Ferry's leaving for another island! Every pelican over this path just wasted a trip.
lines.win: You hardly broke stride all season, and my flock barely flew a wasted mile.
lines.fail: Either you stood waiting on every stretch or my pelicans wore their wings out on paths you never walked.
